name: Darsok Swiftdagger stands on top of the patch-WB1 Crossroads tower (#6229)
contract: Report #6229: Darsok Swiftdagger (3449) is not on top of the Crossroads tower, so his quests cannot be taken there.
Patch-WB1 moved the Crossroads tower; the client QuestSuperTrack point for Darsok is -516.888, -2597.390, 129.469 on map 1.
Darsok's spawn 14415 is a quest giver (npcflag 2) for Harpy Raiders 867 (MinLevel 12, AllowableRaces 690).

A level 12 orc standing at that tower-top point in the world phase must find Darsok within quest-giver reach (30 yards) and take quest 867 from him; the stock spawn point (-474.894, -2607.74) is 43 yards away.

steps.label: Join the world phase Darsok is spawned in
Take Harpy Raiders from Darsok on the tower top
